name: task-shelf
description: A home for small scheduled jobs that have no app of their own, run by the ai-space scheduler, with an overview of every scheduled task on the machine and an AI assistant that manages the jobs. An ai-space app.

scripts.check: bun install && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --root . --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" --outdir dist
